_comment: Canonical allowlist of Claude model IDs approved for OSV agents. Enforced by .ai/build.py --check: every agent frontmatter `model:` field must be a key here. This exists because a floating tier alias (sonnet, haiku, latest) means Anthropic shipping a new model silently changes the behavior of a security gate with no PR, no diff, no review -- see R-22 in .ai/rules.md. Bumping an entry, or approving a new one, requires a reviewed PR against this file.
